`Item` is the loop variable of [LOOP FOREACH Item IN %ItemList%](block:B6) (line 7), which assigns it on every iteration. It is then read in:

- [IF %Item% = Special](block:B7) — line 8
- [To Upper](block:B8) — line 9
- [Set Variable](block:B11) — line 12, in the `Else` branch

No other action writes it. Note that `ItemList` itself is never initialised, so the loop may not run at all.
